items.title: Brands
items.description: First bulk misses the signed fit sample. We grade from that sample and hold the same block on the repeat.

items.title: Retailers
items.description: MOQ is too high to test one new style this season. We quote per style and color so you can run a short size set.

items.title: Agents
items.description: Deposit paid, factory goes quiet on the date. One merchandiser dates the sample and the bulk slot in writing.

items.title: Product developers
items.description: No tech pack, factory will not start. A reference garment plus size range is enough to open a quote.

capabilities.title: What we actually sew.
capabilities.description: Jersey and fleece on knit lines. Shirts, outerwear and uniforms on woven lines.

items.title: Style sheet
items.description: Seam type, trim card and fabric lot written before the marker.

items.title: Grading
items.description: Base size to XS–4XL. Fit sample in the base; size set if you ask.

items.title: Proto / fit / PP
items.description: About 7 days to the first sample when fabric is here. PP signed, then we cut.

items.title: Packing
items.description: Polybag, carton mark, packing list counted at AQL.

process.title: From your file to a cutting ticket.
process.description: Cutting waits for a signed PP. That is the gate.

steps.title: Send the file
steps.description: Tech pack, or a reference garment with fabric, size range and quantity.

steps.title: Get the quote
steps.description: Factory, MOQ per style/color, sample date — within 48 hours.

steps.title: Approve fit
steps.description: Comments on the sample. We do not cut on a chat message.

steps.title: Sign PP
steps.description: Markers lock. Sample fee comes off the bulk invoice.

steps.title: Sew and count
steps.description: Inline measurements by color and size. AQL, then the truck.

warranty.title: When a size or stitch misses the signed sample.
warranty.description: The signed fit sample and the PO are the reference.
warranty.commitment: Measurement claims are checked against the signed size spec and the AQL sheet in the carton.

cases.question: If bulk fit drifts
cases.title: Hold the PO or rework against the signed sample.
cases.description: Cutting starts after PP. Out-of-tolerance sizes are pulled before packing.

cases.question: If shrinkage exceeds the spec
cases.title: Wash test before PP.
cases.description: Wash results sit on the style sheet. Failed lots stay off the cutting ticket.

cases.question: If a carton is short
cases.title: The packing list is the count.
cases.description: Every carton is counted at final audit.

ecosystem.title: Knit lines and woven lines.
